newsitem.title: USA: Amgen to report leptin results in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Amgen to report leptin results in Q2.

text.p: In an update of its product pipeline, Amgen Inc told investors that it will report by the end of the second quarter results of Phase I safety trials of leptin, the human gene believed to regulate body fat.
Amgen also said that it hoped to gain new indications for its Neupogen white blood cell stimulating factor in patients with AIDS and acute myelogenous leukemia.

And it said genomics research had led to the cloning of the telomerase enzyme, which appears to be essential to the growth of most cancer cells. This finding, it said, may provide a "universal target" for cancer drug development.
Amgen also said it will begin clinical trials of leptin in non-insulin dependent type II diabetes within the next 12 months.
